paragraphs: Imi bar Chinena: Jerusalem Talmud Megillah, chapter 1, halakhah 11.
Rav Dimi bar Chinena: Eruvin 61a. Rav Huna bar Chinena: Berakhot 30a.
Rav Chana bar Chinena: Pesachim 106b. Ulla bar Chinena: Sukkah 33a.
Rav Ukva bar Chinena: Pesachim 91a. Ravin bar Chinena: Pesachim 109b.

notes.text: The Megillah 1:11 locator is Jerusalem Talmud. Saved Davidson Berakhot 30a fully writes Rav Huna bar Chinena, supporting that occurrence’s expansion in p003.
